claims: C1 restricted content includes informational hazards
C2 restricted content includes sensitive personal data
C3 transformations of restricted content are allowed

concepts.name: restricted_content
concepts.gloss: C is content that falls under the restricted-content definition: informational hazards or sensitive personal data

concepts.name: informational_hazard
concepts.gloss: C is content that constitutes an informational hazard, as the information-hazards prohibition section describes
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text names informational hazards without defining them

concepts.name: sensitive_personal_data
concepts.gloss: C is sensitive personal data about a person, as the privacy-protection rule section describes
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text names sensitive personal data without defining it

concepts.name: transformation_exception_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the exception rule that allows transformation of user-provided restricted content
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: applies_to
concepts.gloss: exception rule R applies to content C
concepts.inference: the transformation exception must be applicable to particular content for the permission to attach

concepts.name: information_hazards_prohibition
concepts.gloss: R is the section of the Model Spec that prohibits providing detailed, actionable steps for activities that are illicit, could harm people or property, or lead to critical or large-scale harm
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: privacy_protection_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the section of the Model Spec that prohibits responding to requests for private or sensitive information about people
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: disallowed_content_categories
concepts.gloss: C is content that falls under a disallowed content category
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns
